NONE: › having or containing a lot of knowledge that is known by very few people
博學的；有學問的；博大精深的

example: He's the author of an erudite book on Scottish history.
他寫過一本博大精深的有關蘇格蘭歷史的著作。

I: C2 When a volcano erupts, it explodes and flames and rocks come out of it.
› to suddenly express your feelings in a noisy way
爆發（感情）；激烈地表達（感情）
› If spots erupt on your skin, they suddenly appear.

example: Since the volcano last erupted, many houses have been built in a dangerous position on its slopes.
自從火山上次噴發後，很多房屋建在了火山山坡上的危險地帶。
At the end of a hot summer, violence erupted in the inner cities.
一個炎熱的夏末，在市中心貧民區突然爆發了暴力事件。
The crowd erupted in applause and cheering.
人群中爆發出掌聲和歡呼聲。
Two days after he'd been exposed to the substance, a painful rash erupted on his neck.
接觸了這種物質兩天後，他脖子上突然起了一種刺痛的疹子。
